name: Silicon Starter
description: Create, share, and maintain versioned silicon architectures from the terminal or browser. Publish validated silicon.yaml projects, work in editable Git checkouts, and track commits and releases. Search the catalog, download a release, pin a version, or keep a checkout updated. Carbons and Silicons sign in with Silicon Accounts and own their projects directly. Briefcase stores project archives. Git is required for repository operations.
